standards_claimed: InfiniBand Architectural Release 1.3, Volume 2, CXP Specification Release
general.notes: Link distance stated as 100 m on OM3 MMF and 150 m on OM4 MMF (reach_km recorded as 0.1 and 0.15). Bit rate per lane table uses 1000–11318 Mb/sec. LOS Assert (LOSA) min −30.0 dBm, max −15.5 dBm. Page 11 receiver notes include conflicting text referring to 4 lasers/10.5 Gb/s (likely errata vs 12-channel 11.3 Gb/s spec). Requires 3.3 V supply only; 12 V pins not connected. Multirate per channel 1 Gb/s to 11.3 Gb/s. Aggregate maximum data rate 135.816 Gb/s. Copyright/footer references Coherent Corp.; product and certificates reference Finisar Corporation.
